$comment: Hand-filled classification for docs/CAPABILITY_MATRIX.md. Every tool in electron/mcpServer.js createToolDefinitions() needs an entry; scripts/capability-matrix.mjs --check fails otherwise. Verb ids are the clause ids of docs/AI_EDITOR_CONTRACT.md.

get_assets.note: No role or semantic filter until the FILM-2012 asset fields exist; studio_search_assets ranks over it (FILM-2013).

search_stock_media.note: Expert profile only; media comes from the edit package.

find_timeline_items.note: No scene filter: scope by scene needs clip.metadata.semantic.scene (FILM-2012) or a scene-marker range. Read tool, so a compile-time call, never a plan step.

check_media_health.note: The QA 'missing or offline media' check (FILM-2014) calls it as is.

inspect_export_file.note: ffprobe codec, fps, resolution, duration against a target; qa.js reuses it for the probe checks.

check_export_readiness.note: Blockers and warnings for a target; studio_check_readiness adds package, policy and target-duration checks.

inspect_clip.note: One clip, its asset and a still.

inspect_timeline_frame.note: Composed frame; a vision input for the visual analyser.

prepare_generation_from_timeline_context.note: Generation stays in StoryBook (regenerate_shots, FILM-2007); expert profile only.

queue_prepared_generation.note: Expert profile only; may spend credits.

queue_timeline_generation_batch.note: Expert profile only; may spend credits.

generate_music.note: Music arrives in the edit package; local generation is expert only.

get_audio_analysis.note: The PRD's detect_silence step: silence spans, beats, approximate LUFS per asset or clip. Compile-time read; approximate loudness, so not the QA-grade ebur128 check (FILM-2014 qa.js).

inspect_timeline_range.note: Contact sheet of a range; the keyframe tier (FILM-2014) writes files under cache/kf/ instead.

inspect_visible_shots.note: Shot changes with samples; tighten_pacing uses it to find duplicate establishing shots.

split_clip.note: Not plan-writable: add to MCP_ACTION_PLAN_WRITABLE_TOOLS (FILM-2013) before freeze_frame and speed_ramp (FILM-2018) compile to it.

extract_range.note: Ripple range cut, the core of remove_dead_air and hit_duration; not plan-writable, add it (FILM-2013).

set_clip_speed.note: Not plan-writable, add it (FILM-2013); speed_ramp compiles to it (FILM-2018).

set_clip_audio.note: Gain and fades only, no volume envelope; not plan-writable, add it (FILM-2013). Ducking automation is FILM-2016.

open_project.note: studio_open_episode calls it after the FILM-2011 pull has built the folder.

transcribe_captions.note: Background job polled with get_caption_status, so it cannot be a plan step; studio_add_captions sequences it outside run_mcp_action_plan (FILM-2016).

get_caption_status.note: Caption job state and cue draft.

update_caption_cues.note: Not plan-writable (FILM-2013 adds it); takes per-cue globalOverrides and a clip preset, so the styled, safe-area cues from captions/style.js (FILM-2016) land in one call; the move_caption repair.

generate_captions.note: Not plan-writable; BrandSchema.captionStyle maps onto its preset and placement arguments (FILM-2016).

save_project.note: Writes project.comfystudio; a version snapshot is separate (FILM-2012).

analyze_timeline.note: Tiny clips, gaps, overlaps: pacing-analyser inputs.

set_clips_enabled.note: Disable rather than delete when a plan keeps a clip recoverable.

add_timeline_markers.note: The builder writes one marker per scene (FILM-2012).

undo.note: Fast path; durable undo is a version restore (FILM-2012).

create_project_checkpoint.note: Persists to edits/checkpoints/<id>.json in the project and survives a restart (FILM-2010 part A); the renderer map is a cache.

import_asset_from_path.note: Re-sync imports changed media under new names (FILM-2011).

run_mcp_action_plan.note: Preview validates step names only and never calls a step's own previewOnly path; steps must be plan-writable; no reasons[]. FILM-2013 wraps it (contract A3, A4).

create_project.note: The builder writes the Studio project folder itself (FILM-2012).

update_track.note: Volume, pan, mute, inserts; bus routing is FILM-2016.

set_master_audio.note: Master volume and limiter inserts; the normalize_loudness repair. Routed to the renderer in callTool by FILM-2016 (it returned Unknown tool before).

set_audio_buses.note: FILM-2016: per-bus gain, ducking under dialogue (duckDb, attack, release) and the master LUFS target in project.studio.audioBuses; plan-writable; the duck_music and normalize_loudness repairs. The dialogue bus is never ducked.

duplicate_timeline.note: The base of a variant; timeline.studio {kind: variant, variantOf, aspect} is set by FILM-2017.

replace_clip_with_asset.note: Re-sync replacement plans are one call per changed clip (FILM-2011).

add_text_clip.note: add_cta and lower thirds until compositions (FILM-2018); the compiler supplies brand fonts and colours.

set_clip_keyframes.note: punch_in, ken_burns, reframe crop paths; the add_fade repair on visuals.

export_timeline.note: The 720p review render as is; keyframe, scene and audio-only tiers are FILM-2014.

export_delivery_batch.note: Velorn targets; the six StoryBook presets (LUFS, caption policy, renders/<version>/<preset>-<lang>.mp4) arrive with FILM-2017.

build.name: studio_get_context
build.note: Script, scene map, policy, brand, timeline summary, versions, last QA in one call.

build.name: studio_search_assets
build.note: Ranks by semantic fields and transcript.

build.name: studio_get_job_status
build.note: Pull, render and deliver jobs run in main (FILM-2011).

build.name: studio_review
build.note: QA then critic.

build.name: electron/studio/qa.js checks
build.note: ebur128 loudness and true peak, astats clipping, blackdetect, freezedetect, silencedetect, caption safe areas, script coverage. No Velorn tool does these at QA grade.

build.name: src/studio/critic/{pacing,audio,visual}.js
build.note: Analysers return issues in the QA shape.

build.name: studio_repair
build.note: Compiles each issue's repairIntent to a plan.

build.name: studio_render_preview
build.note: Keyframe, scene and audio-only tiers; bypasses the media-preparation queue.

build.name: studio_open_episode
build.note: Starts the FILM-2011 pull and returns a jobId.

build.name: src/studio/projectBuilder.js
build.note: Package to project JSON; not a tool.

build.name: studio_edit
build.note: Intent compilers, plan cards, apply into a version.

build.name: src/studio/oplog.js
build.note: One line per applied step with its reason; not a tool.

build.name: studio_create_version / studio_restore_version
build.note: Over src/studio/versions.js (FILM-2012).

build.name: studio_edit_audio and bus parameters
build.note: Buses, sidechain ducking, stems. Velorn's UI ducking (src/utils/audioDucking.mjs) has no MCP tool.

build.name: studio_add_captions
build.note: Brand style and per-aspect safe areas.

build.name: studio_add_graphic and the composition clip type
build.note: VALIDATION_FAILED 'not available yet' until then.

build.name: set_auto_reframe / set_focal_point
build.note: Subject-tracking crop path as set_clip_keyframes transforms.

build.name: studio_create_variant
build.note: short and hook; language is FILM-2019.

build.name: studio_deliver
build.note: confirm:true needs the renderer's one-time confirmation token.

build.name: studio_check_updates / studio_apply_updates
build.note: Over electron/studio/sync.js (FILM-2011).
